# Texts for posting SimSight elsewhere

Ready to paste. Keep the links: the download always stays on GitHub (checked
fingerprints, updates from the game).

## Short description (one line)

Play The Sims 4 with a screen reader on Mac or Windows, with a phone app for VoiceOver and TalkBack. Alpha.

## Long description

**SimSight Companion** lets blind and low-vision players play The Sims 4.
It speaks menus, dialogs, tooltips, notifications and what your Sim is
doing: with the macOS voices on the Mac, through NVDA or JAWS on Windows.

A phone app (made for VoiceOver on the iPhone, works with TalkBack) shows
the household, needs and moods, and what happens, and lets you play: pause
and speed, actions on Sims and objects, a room-by-room house map, the
game's questions, quick fixes for what needs attention. Made for playing
together (a sighted player on the mouse, a blind player on the phone) or
alone.

- Mac (Apple chip or Intel) and Windows.
- One-line installer that backs up your settings and saves first; updates
  from inside the game.
- Based on TS4 Access by tyjokr, LeonianUniverse and contributors (MIT).
- Free and open source. Not affiliated with EA or Maxis.

**Alpha:** played regularly on a Mac; Windows is new and not yet tried
inside the game. Windows testers wanted.

Guides and install: https://the40n8.github.io/simsight-companion/
Download: https://github.com/the40n8/simsight-companion/releases/latest

## Tags

accessibility, screen reader, blind, VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS, script mod, Mac, Windows

## Call for Windows testers (Discord, forums)

Hi! I'm working on SimSight Companion, an accessibility mod for The Sims 4
based on TS4 Access, with a phone app for VoiceOver. It's played regularly
on a Mac; the Windows version is ready but nobody has played it inside the
game yet.

If you play (or would like to play) The Sims 4 on Windows with NVDA or
JAWS, one evening of trying it would help a lot. Install is one PowerShell
line; it backs up your settings and saves first and can remove itself
again.

What matters most: does anything speak when the game starts, does
Control+Alt+H open the menu, and does the phone app connect?

Guide: https://the40n8.github.io/simsight-companion/testers/
Reports: here, or on GitHub with the test report form.
Thank you!

## Where it can go

- **CurseForge:** its Sims 4 rules accept only `.package` and `.ts4script`
  files in a mod, and no external download links. SimSight needs its helper
  programs (phone companion, tunnel, Mac voice, Windows speech), so it does
  not fit there as it is.
- **Places that allow a link to GitHub:** accessible-game lists, AudioGames
  forum, Reddit (r/blind, r/Sims4), Discord servers, ModTheSims (check its
  current rules for script mods first).
